description:
Goal: document the settled definition lifecycle and remove construction scaffolding. Update .agent/docs/modules.md and pipeline.md: the bootstrap is the only canonical-text exception; index takes stock and stashes raw AST; the define tier expands module-scope macros (use and definition-generators) down to the Compiler.define boundary and notes members raw; bodies expand on reference, recursively, stopping at each Compiler.define unless referenced; a definition carries its env (Elixir cache_env) and __ENV__ is bound with function rebound prior to body expansion. Map the model to Elixir def/store_definition and the northstar laziness ladder.

Grounding: the lifecycle is coherent only after .1 through .4 land; docs must state provable current-state facts only.

Signal: docs reflect code; re-run the tiny + fixture with --log-telemetry and confirm index/stock-take broad, expansion narrow, env carried not discarded; no remaining FunctionEnvSource, ScopeSurfaceMode, or runtime/prelude synonym debt; full lib green with zero warnings.

Strategy: docs and verify. Depends on fz-rh2.28.4.
title: Compiler2 definition lifecycle: docs, scaffolding removal, signal
